summary: Wires DELETE /api/v1/me (login required) to deleteProfile which permanently deletes the user's account and posts; fixes missing Post import; suggested users now last 5.

statements.text: ! People can now delete their own account... make sure the app asks them to confirm first and the rest of their data is deleted or kept the way you want.
statements.why: Accurate; irreversible, no password re-check, partial cleanup (comments, likes, chats remain).

statements.text: The v1 me part of your server now lets people delete their own account. /api/v1/me

misses.what: Deletion is partial and not atomic: user removed first, a missing post makes it fail half-way; comments, likes, saves and chats left behind.
Suggested-users list now shows the last 5 candidate users instead of the first 5.
